source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Benefits of Load Balancing' (PDF 19): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Load balancing network ki speed aur response time (jawab aane ka waqt) behtar karti hai. Yeh server failure (server band hone) ka risk (khatra) kam karti hai. Agar ek server fail ho jaye to baqi kaam karte rehte hain. Is se user experience (user ka tajurba) behtar hota hai. Load balancing high traffic (zyada rash) aasani se handle karne (sambhalne) mein madad deti hai. Yeh network ki reliability (bharosa) aur availability (har waqt dastiyab rehna) barhati hai.

blocks.prompt: Teen servers mein se ek band ho jaye to load balancing se website par kya asar hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Website chalti rehti hai, kyun ke load balancer requests baqi do servers ko bhej deta hai.

items: Fawaid: tez response, server failure ka khatra kam, ek band ho to baqi chalte, zyada traffic, zyada reliability aur availability.
